tasks.short: Monitor game operations, rule compliance and courteous service.

steps.what: Locate the current game procedures, house rules and applicable local compliance instructions
Monitor actual game operations and employee service on the floor against house rules and applicable regulations
outputs: observed operating compliance and service concerns

steps.what: Clarify actual deviations with workers and direct immediate service or procedure corrections within existing authority
inputs: observed operating compliance and service concerns

tasks.design: Configure a game-specific index to controlled procedures in {DOCS}. Keep floor observation, interpretation of actual conduct and direct corrective conversations human; no employee or player classification is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current instructions may require navigation through several procedure sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed views can show the effective rule revision for a game.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing deviations while keeping service calm and fair.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding a live situation and giving proportionate guidance.

ambition.what: No reduction in floor coverage or compliance staffing is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Quicker reference access, unchanged supervisory authority.

reach.learn: Find the controlled rule and refer disputes to the supervisor.

evidence.claim: A native document index can reduce rule retrieval without automating floor supervision.

assumptions: Boundary is reference lookup, live monitoring and direct correction. Incident reports, monetary paperwork and security notification are distinct work and receive no saving here.

The compliance owner produces game ID, jurisdiction, effective date, revision and controlled procedure link. Missing or conflicting instructions are checked manually; no model invents applicable rules.
Try native {DOCS} search and indexed views first. References to tribal, state and federal rules in the source task are replaced by the actual local legal and licensing context; no US rule is assumed.
unknowns: Actual reference lookup time and current index quality.
research_questions: Can supervisors find the effective procedure faster with a native game index?

already_counted.description: Actual monitoring and corrective discussion remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain effective-revision links for the indexed procedures.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only 15 points of retrieval fall to 70%, saving 4.5 less 0.5 upkeep. No adoption if current access is already efficient.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe possible cheating and notify security of supported suspicions.

steps.what: Observe gamblers' actual behavior and game events for possible marking, switching, counting or other prohibited conduct
Assess the observed events and plausible innocent explanations before deciding whether security should be notified
outputs: supported suspicion and uncertainty or no notification decision

steps.what: Formulate and check the exact factual security notification, location, event time, uncertainty and receiving security channel
inputs: supported suspicion and uncertainty or no notification decision
outputs: checked final factual notification and security destination

steps.what: Notify the designated security staff of the checked suspected cheating facts and clarify their actual questions
inputs: checked final factual notification and security destination

tasks.design: Keep observation, judgement and the factual security notification with the supervisor. Test the existing security contact procedure before proposing software; this design finds no changed step that would justify a labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: The events require contextual observation and may be ambiguous.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing contact instructions can support notification, but no new mechanism changes the actual work here.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a reportable suspicion from innocent behavior.
tasks.human_edge: Proportionate judgement and careful factual reporting.

ambition.what: No automatic player flagging or additional surveillance is proposed.

tasks.altitude: No change in decision rights or coverage.

reach.learn: State observations, location and uncertainty without presenting suspicion as fact.

evidence.claim: A contextual suspected-cheating notification still requires human observation, judgement and factual communication.

assumptions: The report preparation and actual notification are split out from floor observation before assigning zero saving. Both remain fully counted. A separate persistent incident record, if required, must be allocated once to the site's incident workflow rather than invented here.

The supervisor produces actual event time, table or location, observed acts, uncertainty and security destination. No structured event or player-risk data is assumed. If no notification is justified, do not send one.
Native security contact lookup was considered; no material repeated navigation or new automation is established. No model or additional upkeep is introduced, so incremental hours are zero.
The normal formulation check in s3 binds a1 to that exact factual report and security destination. Changed facts require another check; this is not an extra approval layer.
unknowns: Actual division between verbal notification and separately required incident documentation.
research_questions: Is there any repeated information entry in a distinct incident workflow that can be improved without classifying players?

already_counted.description: Prepare, check and deliver the actual security notification.

incremental.description: No new system or recurring work introduced.

approvals.approved_version: Exact factual security notification, uncertainty, event location and receiving channel checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Observation, judgement, report preparation and the actual security notification are separate and unchanged; none has a supported reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather actual transaction details and supporting cash or gaming records from the casino transaction system {OTHER}
Verify the actual transaction amount, parties, supporting evidence and discrepancies under the existing monetary-control procedure
outputs: verified facts and resolved or held discrepancies

steps.what: Prepare the required transaction form and evidence references in the casino transaction system {OTHER}
inputs: verified facts and resolved or held discrepancies

steps.what: Check the complete final transaction paperwork against actual evidence, required fields and exact record destination
outputs: checked final transaction form and exact filing target

steps.what: Commit only the checked transaction paperwork to the internal casino records system {OTHER}
inputs: checked final transaction form and exact filing target

tasks.design: Configure native transaction lookup and required form population in the casino records system {OTHER}. Preserve actual monetary-control checks and complete final verification; commit the paperwork through its normal checked save without executing a payout or external filing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual transaction facts may be copied into required forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native transaction IDs and form field mappings can reuse the recorded facts deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving discrepancies and meeting the actual control requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Recognizing evidence gaps and stopping an unsupported form.

ambition.what: No increase in gambling activity or automatic payout is proposed.

tasks.altitude: Less copying, unchanged transaction control authority.

reach.task: Reconcile transaction evidence to internal records
reach.learn: Preserve voucher references and discrepancy holds.

evidence.claim: Native transaction-linked forms can avoid repeated copying of actual recorded facts.

assumptions: Boundary is transaction paperwork. Authorizing or executing money movement, customer due diligence and statutory reports remain in their own workflows.

The cashier or authorized gaming system produces transaction ID, timestamp, amount, currency, type, party reference, voucher ID and status. Missing paper vouchers are manually captured and checked; no transaction is inferred from an expected jackpot or draft form.
Try native lookup and form configuration before a connector. Low assumes no adoption when records are already populated or only paper exists. Existing system processing receives no labour benefit.

a1 binds the complete form version, evidence references and filing target checked in s4; edits void it. Save remains 1% fully retained. Existing dual-control labour, if required, must be measured separately and is not removed.
unknowns: Current source fields and form population coverage.
Which transaction classes require another role's verification.
research_questions: Can native forms reuse actual transactions while retaining all discrepancy and dual-control holds?

already_counted.description: Review populated form fields and verify the complete final paperwork.

incremental.description: Maintain transaction-form mappings and test changed field requirements.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final transaction form, evidence references and exact internal filing target checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual source retrieval saves 13.75 points and form copying 22.75; gross 36.5 less 2 upkeep. Actual evidence checks and the ordinary save remain unchanged.

tasks.short: Maintain knowledge of games and cheating methods.

steps.what: Find current game rules and authorized security training materials
Study the actual rules, game play and documented strategies or tricks used by cheaters
outputs: personal understanding of rules and documented methods

steps.what: Work through authorized examples or demonstrations to recognize game behavior and limits of apparent indicators
inputs: personal understanding of rules and documented methods

steps.what: Discuss unclear game procedures and suspected-cheating examples with experienced colleagues or authorized trainers

tasks.design: Configure a game-specific learning index across {DOCS} and the {LMS}. Keep studying, practice and discussion fully human; retrieved material is not proof that the supervisor learned it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant approved materials can be scattered by game or training topic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tags and catalogue views can reduce repeated searching.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing context and avoiding false certainty about conduct.
tasks.human_edge: Learning from experienced colleagues and testing understanding.

ambition.what: No automatic competence or additional surveillance is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less material searching, unchanged supervision role.

reach.task: Discuss a game-rule ambiguity during training
reach.learn: Use current rules and distinguish a training example from an allegation.

evidence.claim: Native catalogue tags can improve retrieval of approved learning material without replacing learning time.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining familiarity, not monitoring a particular player or preparing a new training manual. There is no separate report, send or competence-record write assumed here.

Training owners produce game ID, material ID, revision, access restriction and effective date. Missing metadata is indexed manually with owner confirmation; unverified online content is not added automatically.
Test native catalogue filters first. No model, completion inference or recording is introduced.
unknowns: Whether approved materials already have effective game tags.
research_questions: Does native game filtering reduce search while leaving actual study and practice unchanged?

already_counted.description: Actual study, practice and discussion remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain current game-material tags and access links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only 20 points of material search fall to 60%, saving 8 less 0.5 upkeep. No adoption if the current catalogue already does this.
